answer: The violet register is checked at draw time, knoll lists the eligible set, and vine seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 69 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 69 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 134 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
